reason: Cursor's transcript discovery cannot identify the active session in other harnesses; owner directive 2026-11-03 (ADR0023) delivers approved skill edits through the maintained source and ship-loop, not local copies without a PR.

edits.before:
Before fanning out, find this conversation's transcript in the `agent-transcripts/` directory the system prompt names. Do not glob across `~/.cursor/projects/*/`. That crosses workspace boundaries and reads private chats from unrelated projects.

```bash
ls -t <agent-transcripts>/*.jsonl <agent-transcripts>/*/*.jsonl <agent-transcripts>/*/subagents/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -10
```

That covers the legacy flat (`<id>.jsonl`), current nested (`<id>/<id>.jsonl`), and subagent (`<parent>/subagents/<child>.jsonl`) layouts. For each candidate, read the first JSONL line. Take the file whose `message.content[0].text` contains the conversation's opening user prompt. If none matches, pass a tight digest of the session instead.
edits.after: Before fanning out, find this conversation's transcript through the native session history in the pstack names adapter. Do not search unrelated workspaces; that reads private chats from unrelated projects. Match the conversation's opening user prompt. If none matches, pass a tight digest of the session instead.

edits.before: Never edit a skill under `plugins/cache/`. Before approval, show its destination, `.cursor/skills/<skill>/` or `~/.cursor/skills/<skill>/`. After approval, copy the skill folder there and edit the copy. Never open a PR or push.
edits.after: Never edit an installed plugin copy. Before approval, show each edit's maintained source: the repository that owns the skill, or a project `.agents/skills/<skill>/`. A vendored skill changes through its owner's lock and recorded patches, not hand edits. After approval, deliver each accepted edit through [ship-loop](../ship-loop/SKILL.md).
